candidates.statement: Payment service latency is elevated (p95 1600ms) with 504 downstream_deadline_exceeded warnings, and gateway traces show ERROR on the call to payment at 973ms, indicating downstream latency at payment as the checkout error/latency cause.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within payment (internal vs its own downstream) is not localized by current evidence.

report.explanation: Gateway traces show ERROR calling payment at 973ms; payment p95 is 1600ms with 504 downstream_deadline_exceeded warnings, while order, inventory, and gateway metrics are healthy. This supports downstream latency at payment. Deployment record alone cannot establish causation.
missing_evidence: Payment downstream dependency spans to localize the slow call
